_metadata.author: Sam Cao
_metadata.description: Manifest of every item on the presentations site; tools/build_site.py builds the site from it.
_metadata.ai_update: Update last_updated and version. Append to _changelog array. Bump an item's version when its file changes.

title: Presentations & Study Materials
description: Slide decks, study sheets, games, and handouts I've made for teaching robotics and engineering.

items.title: FRC Introductory Guide
items.description: FIRST history and core values, every FRC game from 1992 to 2026, legendary teams, suppliers, and the community tools and training resources worth knowing.

items.title: FRC Drive Bases & Mechanisms
items.description: Tank, West Coast, mecanum, swerve, and H-drive compared, plus intakes, elevators, arms, shooters, and climbers.

items.title: Drive Type Showdown
items.label: Game
items.description: Browser game where you drive every FRC drive type (tank, arcade, swerve, holonomic) head to head, with arcade modes and a story-driven career tutorial.

items.title: The Engineering Design Process
items.description: The seven-step engineering design process, its three iteration loops, and what each loop looks like on an FRC team. Steps adapted from Science Buddies.

items.title: Punk Rock Engineering
items.description: When to build fast and break things, and when to slow down and apply rigor. Inspired by SuperfastMatt.

items.title: Intro to CAD: FRC Edition
items.label: Study sheet + quiz
items.description: Parametric modeling, constraints, features, surfaces, drawings, BOMs, FEA, and the CAD software landscape, with a quiz at the end.

items.title: The Acute Gusset Project
items.label: Project handout
items.description: Design one gusset in Onshape, then laser cut it in wood and 3D print it. Includes an Onshape checklist and the deliverables.

items.title: Batteries & Power Electronics
items.description: 18650 cells, pack voltages, BMS, why FRC uses AGM lead-acid, transformers, rectifiers, buck converters, and USB PD.

items.title: Batteries & Power Electronics Study Sheet
items.description: Companion to the Batteries & Power Electronics deck, with a diagram for every topic.

items.title: FRC Electrical Systems Reference
items.description: From atoms and Ohm's law to resistors, capacitors, inductors, flyback diodes, and transformers, with practical FRC examples.

items.title: FRC Multimeter Challenge
items.label: Game
items.description: Troubleshoot a robot with a virtual multimeter: find opens and shorts, check the battery, and pick the right meter mode before you fry it.

items.title: FRC Electrical Jeopardy
items.label: Game
items.description: Jeopardy-style review game on FRC electrical topics, built for a classroom projector.

items.title: Fasteners Study Sheet
items.description: Threads and callouts, tapping and drill charts, head and drive types, grades, torque, loosening, rivets, and which fastener to use when.

items.title: Fasteners & Tools Jeopardy
items.label: Game
items.description: Jeopardy-style review game on tools, threads, and thread-locker, built for a classroom projector.

items.title: FRC Material Selection Reference
items.label: Interactive reference
items.description: 38 materials compared for FRC use, with a material-selection quiz, a fabrication-method guide, and charts.

items.title: Printable Fastener Tools (Bolt Depot)
items.label: External chart
items.description: Bolt Depot's free printable bolt, nut, and thread gauges. Linked rather than rehosted because the charts are Bolt Depot's.

items.title: Tap Drill Sizes (LittleMachineShop)
items.label: External chart
items.description: LittleMachineShop's tap drill chart for inch and metric threads. Linked rather than rehosted because the chart is theirs.

items.title: Digital Fabrication Review
items.label: Interactive review
items.description: CNC and G-code, 3D printing, infill and layer strength, laser cutters and the EM spectrum, and color as bytes, with interactives and a review quiz.

items.title: FDM / FFF 3D Printing Review
items.description: 52-section deep dive on FDM printing: motion systems, extruders, nozzles, cooling, bed adhesion, safety, and a complete materials guide.

items.title: 3D Printing Beyond FDM
items.description: Resin (SLA and MSLA), SLS, HP MJF, Markforged fiber, metal printing, tolerances, print services, and design for additive manufacturing.

items.title: 5S: Lean Manufacturing Principles
items.description: Kaizen, the five S's (plus safety), and PDCA, with shop-floor examples of each step.

items.title: 5S Quiz
items.label: Worksheet
items.description: Printable worksheet: name each S and explain it in your own words. Pairs with the 5S deck.

items.title: So You Wanna Find a Job?
items.description: Choosing a path, what a real job hunt looks like, resumes, LinkedIn, interviews, and salary negotiation.

items.title: Mock Interview Question Bank
items.description: Interview questions for engineering roles from intern to quality manager, plus software, embedded, and problem-solving prompts.

items.title: Rambots Framework Guide
items.label: Facilitator guide
items.description: A facilitator reference for 71 team frameworks: decisions, planning, root cause, retros, and brainstorming. Each tool has steps, history with sources, FRC examples, a tool finder, and a practice quiz.

items.title: Rambots Framework Toolkit
items.label: Interactive toolkit
items.description: Interactive worksheets for 71 decision, planning, brainstorming, and review frameworks, with a built-in study guide. Fill them in live in meetings, then save, export, or copy each one.

items.title: Rambots Harada Chart
items.label: Interactive worksheet
items.description: Write one SMART goal for the 2027 season, then break it into 8 pillars and up to 64 small actions on a 9x9 Harada chart. Save it as a Markdown file to turn in, or export a PNG or PDF.

items.title: New Driver Reference
items.label: Study sheet + interactives
items.description: A 66-section reference for new drivers: licensing, how cars work, tires, brakes, maintenance, bad weather, emergencies, buying a car, and insurance, with 11 interactives.

items.title: Shop Safety Quiz, Pilot
items.label: Pilot quiz
items.description: Pilot run of the group 1 shop safety quiz: Part 1 (PPE, conduct, hazards) or Part 2 (emergencies and first aid), with a score, missed questions, and a copy-results button.

items.title: Shop Safety
items.label: Study guide · Group 1 (1.28)
items.description: PPE, conduct, and hazards (Part 1); emergencies, situations, and first aid (Part 2).

items.title: Measuring and Layout
items.label: Study guide · Group 3
items.description: Tapes, calipers, the micrometer, marking, thread checking, fits, and shop math.

items.title: Hand and Bench Tools
items.label: Study guide · Group 4
items.description: Hand tools, tapping, the arbor press, broaching, rivets, rivet nuts, and chain.

items.title: Electrical
items.label: Study guide · Group 5
items.description: Tools and practices, electrical theory with worked math, and battery handling.

items.title: Drill and Drive
items.label: Study guide · Group 6
items.description: Drill and driver controls, bits, holes, screws, impacts, sanders, and threadlocker.

items.title: Heat Press
items.label: Study guide · 2.1
items.description: Setup, the hot platen, mirroring, loading, settings, peeling, and shutting down.

items.title: Cricut
items.label: Study guide · 2.2
items.description: Blades, mats, mirroring, weeding, and applying vinyl.

items.title: 3D Printer
items.label: Study guide · 2.3
items.description: Burns, reaching in, materials, first layers, clogs, and failed prints.

items.title: Laser Cutter
items.label: Study guide · 2.4
items.description: Approved materials, the BOFA, test cuts, staying with the job, and what to do if it flares.

items.title: Hot Glue
items.label: Study guide · 2.5
items.description: The stand, burns, strain relief, and drips.

items.title: Fasteners
items.label: Study guide · B1
items.description: Sizes like 10-32, heads and drives, nylocs, threadlocker, rivets, and rivet nuts.

items.title: Materials and FDM
items.label: Study guide · Materials and FDM
items.description: Aluminum, polycarbonate, wood sheet, and 3D printing filaments and strength.

items.title: Jigsaw
items.label: Study guide · 7.1
items.description: Blades, clamping, hands, curves, and cutting plastic.

items.title: Circular Saw
items.label: Study guide · 7.2
items.description: Depth, support, the guard, binding, and kickback.

items.title: Track Saw
items.label: Study guide · 7.3
items.description: The track, setup, plunge cuts, and body position.

items.title: Miter Saw
items.label: Study guide · 7.4
items.description: Wood only, the no-hands zone, clamping, stops, and unplugging.

items.title: Metal Chop Saw
items.label: Study guide · 7.5
items.description: Blades, the vise, short stock, jams, chips, and hearing.

items.title: Portaband
items.label: Study guide · 7.6, 7.7, 8.4
items.description: Handheld, on the horizontal stand, and on the vertical stand: blades, feeding, stalls, and coasting.

items.title: Angle Grinder
items.label: Study guide · 7.8, 7.9
items.description: Grinding (Section A) and the cut-off wheel (Section B): guards, grip, binding, and the plane of the wheel.

items.title: Rotary Tool
items.label: Study guide · 7.10
items.description: Collets, bits and wheels, speed, and clamping small parts.

items.title: Oscillating Tool
items.label: Study guide · 7.11
items.description: Blades, plunge and flush cuts, heat, and cutting near the robot.

items.title: Reciprocating Saw
items.label: Study guide · 7.12
items.description: Blades, the shoe, cutting into walls, and finishing a cut.

items.title: Router
items.label: Study guide · 7.13
items.description: Bits, collets, depth per pass, and feed direction outside and inside a cutout.

items.title: Drill Press
items.label: Study guide · 8.1
items.description: Clamping, speeds, depth stops, the chuck key, and parts that grab and spin.

items.title: Belt and Disc Sander
items.label: Study guide · 8.2
items.description: The down side of the disc, small parts, angles, dust, and coasting.

items.title: Scroll Saw
items.label: Study guide · 8.3
items.description: Blades, tension, the hold-down, inside cuts, and clearing the table.

items.title: Table Saw
items.label: Study guide · 8.5
items.description: Kickback, the riving knife, push sticks, blade height, stance, and the fence.

items.title: Bench Grinder
items.label: Study guide · 8.6
items.description: Rest and tongue gaps, wheel ratings, soft metals, start-up, and heat.

items.title: CNC Router
items.label: Study guide · 8.7
items.description: Zeroing, collets, workholding, the e-stop, dust, and staying with the job.

_changelog.note: Drive Bases, Engineering Design Process, Punk Rock Engineering, and the FRC Introductory Guide (v1.1: founder names and unverified claims removed) locked behind the Konami code.
Fixed the Drive Type Showdown link (repo path is case-sensitive: DriveTypeShowdown).
Added Rambots Framework Guide and Framework Toolkit (new Team Leadership topic) and New Driver Reference (new Life Skills topic, locked behind the Konami code).
New Driver v1.2.1: corrected loaded-vehicle braking physics and replaced unverified Tire Rack wet-braking figures with sourced, braking-only test findings.
Added the Rambots Harada Chart v2.1 (SMART goal plus 9x9 Harada chart) under Team Leadership.
Added the Shop Safety Quiz pilot (v0.2, from safety quiz bank v0.2) under Shop Practices, locked behind the Konami code. Answer key is hashed and missed questions don't reveal answers.
Shop Safety Quiz pilot v0.3: removed the CA glue question; the two mentor-present questions now ask only about cutting tools.
Added the Tool Study Guides topic: 29 interactive study guides, one per tool or concept quiz, in the order students take them.
CNC Router study guide v1.1.2: gloves card removed.
Safety, Electrical, Laser Cutter, Drill Press, and CNC Router study guides updated: both extinguisher locations, footer version labels.
CNC Router study guide v1.1.4: new e-stop checkpoint situations.
Shop Safety study guide v1.0.6: walk-around table adds the fire blanket.
Table Saw, Bench Grinder, and CNC Router study guides get photos.
Final-sweep wording fixes: Measuring, Electrical, Jigsaw, Circular Saw, Track Saw, Metal Chop Saw, Portaband.
